title: Qcqs higher direct images preserve a fixed set of torsion primes
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\mathcal P$ be any set of primes and let $F\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$ be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Assume that for every geometric point $\bar u$ of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and every $x\in F_{\bar u}$ there is a positive integer $n$ with $nx=0$ and with every prime divisor of $n$ in $\mathcal P$. Then for every integer $q\geq0$, every geometric point $\bar v$ of $V$, and every $y\in(R^qu_*F)_{\bar v}$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], there is a positive integer $m$ with $my=0$ and with every prime divisor of $m$ in $\mathcal P$.

source.place: Tag 0DDD, lemma-torsion-direct-image (1), with the fixed-prime refinement of the proof of Tag 0DDC, lemma-torsion-cohomology (1): restrict annihilators to integers with prime divisors in P.

proof.text: Let I be the positive natural numbers whose prime divisors lie in P, ordered by divisibility. The integer 1 is an index, and multiplication supplies a common upper bound: a prime dividing nm divides n or m. For each n form the kernel subobject F[n] of n times the identity of F. Divisibility makes these subobjects monotone, so their underlying objects form a filtered diagram D and their subobject arrows form a cocone c with vertex F. Existence of the small colimit and exactness of filtered colimits are supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaves-filtered-colimits-exact].

source.place: Tags 0DDC and 0DDD, fixed-prime kernel-union argument; Tag 09Z1, constant-scheme case of relative higher-image continuity. Coefficient comparison uses Cohomology on Sites Tags 03FD and 072W.

proof.text: The induced map t:colim D to F is mono: all the subobject arrows are mono and exact filtered colimits preserve this mono natural transformation into the constant diagram. To prove t epi, let g,h:F to G agree after t. They agree after every kernel-subobject arrow. At the algebraic-closure point over each point of U, take x in the stalk of F and an allowed positive annihilator n from hF. Exactness of the stalk functor [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact] lifts x through the stalk of ker(n id_F). Transfer the equality on F[n] along kernelSubobjectIso to that kernel. Applying the stalk functor gives g(x)=h(x). The geometric-stalk equality detector sheafHom_ext_of_sheafFiber_map_algClosurePoint, proved from the conservative family in [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative], gives g=h. Hence t is epi as well as mono, thus is an isomorphism in the abelian sheaf category, and c is colimiting.

source.place: Tags 0DDC and 0DDD, fixed-prime kernel-union argument; Tag 09Z1, constant-scheme case of relative higher-image continuity. Coefficient comparison uses Cohomology on Sites Tags 03FD and 072W.

proof.text: For any additive functor H from abelian etale sheaves on U to abelian groups which preserves filtered colimits indexed in Type 0, the cocone H(c) is colimiting. The forgetful functor from abelian groups preserves these filtered colimits, so [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise], using the abelian-group form Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep, represents any y in H(F) by z in H(F[n]) for some n in I. The kernel-subobject arrow is mono and its composite with n id_F is zero; cancellation therefore proves n id_F[n]=0. Additivity of H gives n id_H(F[n])=0, hence nz=0. The additive cocone leg then gives ny=0, and n is positive with all prime divisors in P by its membership in I. This is the private proved helper prime_torsion_of_filtered_functor.

proof.text: Put Lambda=ULift Z in the coefficient universe. Forgetting Lambda-modules to abelian groups is an equivalence: restrict scalars along the inverse ULift integer ring equivalence and use Mathlib ModuleCat.forget₂AddCommGroupIsEquivalence. Whisker its adjunction by the opposite etale site and restrict along the fully faithful sheaf-to-presheaf functors. This gives an equivalence A_T between Lambda-module sheaves and abelian sheaves for T=U,V. Its inverse is additive, and both directions preserve colimits. The canonical integer action is uniquely determined by the abelian group; no arbitrary witness of a mere existence theorem defines data.

proof.text: Let M be the functor on Lambda-module sheaves given by placing a sheaf in degree zero, applying derived direct image along f, and taking degree q homology. The existing theorem preservesColimitsOfShape_higherDirectImage from [lemma-weil-pbc-direct-image-filtered-colimit] proves that M preserves all filtered diagrams indexed in Type 0, under exactly QuasiCompact f and QuasiSeparated f, with no global qcqs assumption. Let T be the geometric stalk functor at s, and set H=A_U inverse followed by M, A_V, and T. The equivalences preserve colimits. The stalk functor preserves colimits by [lem-kun-stalks-commute-colimits], here obtained directly from Mathlib Point.skyscraperSheafAdjunction, and it is additive. Single, derived direct image, homology, and coefficient forgetting are additive as well. Thus H satisfies step 3.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sbc-higher-direct-image-forget-comparison] to A_U inverse(F). Compose the resulting isomorphism with the abelian higher-direct-image functor applied to the coefficient equivalence counit A_U(A_U inverse(F)) isomorphic to F, and then take the stalk. This gives an additive isomorphism e:H(F) isomorphic to the target stalk in the statement. Apply step 3 to e inverse(y), obtaining a positive allowed n annihilating it. Apply e to that equality; preservation of natural-number multiples and zero and e composed with its inverse give ny=0. This closes the stated theorem without new assumptions or any new sorry.
